title: Booking seminar rooms without clashes

authoring.author: Parikshaa content team
authoring.originality: Written for Parikshaa: our own seminar room booking design case and kata, examples, code, quiz and explanations; no text from any site, book or course.

scenario: Departments book the college's seminar rooms for talks and viva sessions. Design and code the booking core: given a group size and a time range, give them the **smallest** free room that fits, so big rooms stay available for big groups; allow cancellation; show each room's agenda.

clarifying_questions.q: Can two bookings touch, one ending at 10:00 and the next starting at 10:00?

clarifying_questions.a: The smallest capacity that fits; equal capacities by room name.
Yes, times are HH:MM within one day.
Increasing from 1, never reused, even after cancellation.

functional: Book the smallest free room that fits a group and a time range
Show a room's agenda in time order

non_functional.name: Correctness
non_functional.target: no two bookings in one room overlap

non_functional.name: Scale
non_functional.target: tens of rooms, hundreds of bookings a day: linear scans are fine

entities.name: Room
entities.responsibility: Name, capacity and its bookings; answers whether a time range is free.

entities.name: Scheduler
entities.responsibility: All rooms, the booking id counter, the best-fit choice, cancellation and the id-to-room index.

patterns.name: Half-open intervals
patterns.why: With [start, end), back-to-back meetings do not clash and the overlap test is one line: not (end <= s or e <= start).

patterns.name: Best fit
patterns.why: Choosing the smallest room that fits keeps large rooms free for large groups.

patterns.name: Index by id
patterns.why: A map from booking id to room makes cancellation O(1) instead of searching every room.

diagram.alt: Class diagram: Scheduler holds rooms by name, an index from booking id to room name and the next id; Room holds name, capacity and bookings, with an isFree method.

data.source:
classDiagram
  class Scheduler {
    rooms: Map~name, Room~
    where: Map~id, name~
    nextId
    book(size, start, end)
    cancel(id)
    agenda(name)
  }
  class Room {
    name
    capacity
    bookings: Map~id, interval~
    isFree(start, end) bool
  }
  Scheduler o-- Room

kata.io_protocol:
| Command | Prints |
|---|---|
| `ROOM <name> <capacity>` | `room <name> for <capacity>` or `error: room <name> exists` |
| `BOOK <size> <HH:MM> <HH:MM>` | `booking <id>: <room>` or `error: no room free` |
| `CANCEL <id>` | `cancelled <id>` or `error: no booking <id>` |
| `AGENDA <room>` | `<id>: HH:MM-HH:MM` lines in time order, `<room>: free all day`, or `error: no room <room>` |

Start must be before end. Anything else: `error: bad command <line>`.

rubric.criterion: Overlap uses half-open intervals correctly; back-to-back bookings are allowed.
Room answers availability; Scheduler chooses and indexes; the driver parses.
BOOKROOM reuses the room's availability check and the booking helper.
Naming and clarity (AI feedback, advice only).

concept_checks.stem: Booking A is 10:00-11:00. Does 11:00-12:00 clash with it?
Which condition means [s1, e1) and [s2, e2) overlap?
concept_checks.explanation: They overlap exactly when each starts before the other ends.

concept_checks.stem: Rooms of capacity 4, 10 and 4 (named Tapti, Kaveri, Ganga) are free. A group of 3 books. Which room?
concept_checks.explanation: Smallest capacity that fits is 4; between Ganga and Tapti, the name decides: Ganga.

concept_checks.stem: Why keep an index from booking id to room?
options: So cancel finds the booking in O(1) instead of scanning all rooms
It is required for overlap checks

follow_ups: Suggest the nearest free slot when no room is free at the asked time.
With thousands of bookings per room, how would you speed up the free check (sorted list with binary search, interval tree)?

revision_card.front: Room booking LLD: overlap test, which room to pick, and the cancellation trick?
revision_card.back: Half-open [start, end): overlap iff s1 < e2 and s2 < e1 (back-to-back is fine). Best fit: smallest capacity that fits, ties by name. Map booking id → room for O(1) cancel; ids never reused.
